structured.answer: I didn't pick anything. I'll ask my son or the bank: the page is endless rows of numbers and it never says plainly which track is as safe as a deposit, so I couldn't find "the good one". The only things I took away: the fees are about 0.5%–0.7%, and the "כספי (שקלי)" tracks show around 4.3%–4.6% for 3 years.
